description: The GoldCoach scripts held (the latest version of each): their labels, their tags (life stage, situation, goal), their three stages (get to know them, navigate the choices, come to a decision), the CourseShelf areas they rely on, and the trial (the opening script plus one avenue). The opening script, Getting to know each other, always runs first; after it, offer the scripts whose tags fit where the person is and where they want to go, and let the person choose. Send tags to list only the ones that fit.
